run_versiongenerate: run versiongenerate.py with input_dir and output_dir to extract version from configure.ac and write Version.h
extract_version_from_configure_ac: extract the major minor and fix version numbers from the AC_INIT macro in configure.ac using regex
generate_version_header: generate a Version.h header file with GTEST_VERSIONINFO_SHORT and GTEST_VERSIONINFO_LONG defines from extracted version
parse_ac_init_version: parse the AC_INIT macro in configure.ac to find a bracketed version string like [1.0.1]
write_gtest_version_info: write GTEST version short and long info defines to a header file for Info.plist substitution
